description: Roll back a committed import — staged or inline (governed two-step, destructive): for sales-order imports, soft-deletes every order the session created and removes their seeded demand records so velocity/forecasting return to the pre-import state; for purchase-order imports, soft-deletes the POs; for customer-return imports (staged or import_customer_returns), soft-deletes the return orders so demand stops netting them. Catalog entities the import created (items, customers, UOMs, suppliers) are NOT removed — they may be referenced elsewhere; say so when reporting. Call with preview=true first, then repeat with the previewReceipt and a fresh idempotencyKey.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt.

preview.description: Set true for the dry-run preview.

previewReceipt.description: The receipt returned by the preview call.
